title: A Debt for the Extraction
author: Noor Coldharbour
blurb: Astrid Voss, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
